title: 2.5D talking concept (sprites)
note: The exact Gemini concept look, animated: 1 base portrait + 23 Gemini face edits (15 Oculus visemes, blink, gaze, 5 expressions) cut into mouth/eyes/brows layers over a glasses-free face, with the original glasses on top. Blinks while talking, breathing + small head sway, TTS clips lip-synced via Rhubarb phone alignment. ~26 Gemini calls / ~3 min / ~0.5 MB WebP per user; no head turns.
